29174.subject: Government
29174.question_text: Which public commission was not established by the 1979 Nigerian Constitution?
29174.explanation:
The 1979 Nigerian Constitution established or provided for several public institutions, including:

  • Federal Electoral Commission (FEDECO) – for conducting elections
  • Public Service Commission – for managing civil service appointments and discipline
  • Public Complaints Commission – for handling grievances against government agencies
  • National Population Commission – for population census and demographic data

However, the Udoji Commission was not created by the 1979 Constitution. It was a 1972–1974 administrative reform commission set up earlier under the military government to review and improve the Nigerian public service.

29190.explanation: The Independence Constitution of 1960 was a result of negotiations between Nigerian leaders and the British government.
